terminal_report_handoff.deployment_order: deploy and read back the v1/v2-capable crm_billing_orchestrator before the v2 producer; keep call ingress dark until isolated synthetic compatibility evidence passes
terminal_report_handoff.consumer: crm_billing_orchestrator sync_report_summary on its existing Advanced I/O route
authentication: action-scoped REPORT_SUMMARY_HEADER_VALUE supplied under SHARED_HEADER_NAME (the worker uses CRM_BILLING_SHARED_HEADER_NAME)
terminal_report_handoff.claim: atomic pending-to-processing claim, or processing pre-write reclaim, fenced by OPERATION_VERSION and exact report_claim token readback
terminal_report_handoff.write_boundary: an exact version-fenced report_write_started marker must be read back before CRM PUT; only report_claim processing rows are reclaimable
terminal_report_handoff.ambiguous_replay: report_write_started processing or reconciliation_required never repeats the CRM write; exact Deal readback alone may complete
terminal_report_handoff.terminal_transition: completion and containment use compare-and-set over expected ROWID, STATUS, LAST_OUTCOME, and OPERATION_VERSION with exact incremented-version readback; one bounded retry permits only cursor advancement with unchanged status/outcome and never overwrites a semantic conflict; after observing the operation cursor, every transition to completed and every completed replay fresh-reads the authoritative Deal account, deployment/configuration binding, and exact patch; mismatch or unavailable readback CAS-keeps or demotes reconciliation, and stale containment that observes a winning completion gets one fresh read plus at most one repair CAS
terminal_report_handoff.deal_status_boundary: a differing terminal patch may transition only an unreviewed Live Test_Status to Completed; Completed is exact-replay-only and Failed, Rolled Back, reviewed, or accepted evidence is contained for reconciliation
terminal_report_handoff.completed_gate: CRMBillingOperations STATUS completed and LAST_OUTCOME report_summary_readback_confirmed plus exact Analytics final fact
terminal_report_handoff.workflow_boundary: normal Deal update never writes Stage or Results_Review_At; a human invokes the valid Complete Free Test Blueprint transition after summary readback
terminal_report_handoff.test_new_service_inquiries: excluded and not inferred because the report contract has no separate authoritative metric with that semantic
